title: Chicken Tagine with Spicy Moroccan Flair
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by Moroccan cuisine, featuring chicken cooked in a spicy tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the olive tapenade (if using) and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chicken tagine spice blend and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro (if desired).
Traditionally, a tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, which allows the steam to rise and condense, creating a rich and flavorful sauce.
If you don't have a clay pot, you can cook the tagine in a Dutch oven or other heavy pot with a lid.
Serve with couscous, rice, or bread for a hearty and flavorful meal.
